title: Do Heat Shields Really Melt During Re‑Entry?

scenes.text: The Apollo capsule endured 11,000 °C during re‑entry!
People think the heat shield burns away completely, leaving the capsule exposed.
scenes.label: Heat shield fully burns

scenes.text: In reality, ablative shields slowly char and erode, carrying heat away while keeping the interior below 200 °C.
scenes.label: Ablative shields erode safel

scenes.text: Your capsule stays cool thanks to controlled erosion.
scenes.label: Controlled Erosion
scenes.sub: The shield sacrificially chars, protecting the crew.

scenes.text: Follow for a new science fact every day.

description: The myth that heat shields melt away is wrong—ablative materials erode in a controlled way, keeping spacecraft safe. Follow for daily science!
